system.description:
The ultimate Uchiha Fire Release. You conjure three flaming tornados. Each tornado is a column, that is 5-feet wide and 30-feet tall. The tornado is always centered on a point. Creatures within the tornadoes area when you cast this jutsu and whose space the tornadoes pass through must make a Dexterity saving throw taking 5d12+5 Fire damage, gaining 2 ranks of Burned and having their speed reduced by 15 feet until the end of their next turn on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

As a bonus action on each of your turns, you may command each tornado separately, moving them up to 30 feet each, ending their movement on a point. A creature cannot be forced to make a saving throw as a result of a tornado more than once per turn.

The Flaming tornados have 40 hit points and an AC of 10. When their Hit points are reduced to 0, they explode dealing 4d12+4 fire damage to all creatures within 10 feet of it.

Off-Guard. Creatures with Off-Guard make their saving throws with disadvantage.
